title: EtaleLimitCanonicalCohomologyDiagram
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D:I^op -> Sch an arbitrary inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and c a cone with projections f_i:c.pt -> D_i [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let F_i be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and phi_f:D(f^op)^*F_i -> F_j for f:i -> j, satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition equations [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let G:I -> Ab(c.pt_et) have specified isomorphisms eG_i:G_i ≅ f_i^*F_i, with G(f) equal to conjugation by eG of the inverse-image composition isomorphism followed by f_j^*(phi_f). Let L be ANY cocone of G, not necessarily a colimit. For each n>=0 there exist a functor H:I -> Ab with isomorphisms eH_i:H_i ≅ H^n(D_i,F_i) [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] whose arrows are conjugate to H^n(phi_f) after cohomology pullback D(f^op)^* [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. There exist a cocone B of H and an isomorphism eB:B.pt ≅ H^n(c.pt,L.pt) such that B_i followed by eB is eH_i followed by f_i^* and H^n((eG_i)^-1 followed by L_i). No scheme limit, qcqs condition, affine transitions, exactness or connecting morphism is assumed or asserted.

proof.text: Define H_i as AddCommGrpCat.of of degree-n cohomology of F_i and each transition as ofHom of H.map(phi_f) composed with cohomologyMap(D.map(f.op)). For identity, apply the coefficient identity hypothesis, transport the cohomology pullback across D.map_id using the generic functor_transport_map equality lemma instantiated with Sheaf.functorH, and use the identity clause of cohomologyPullbackFunctorial. For composition, expand hcomposition and H.map_comp_apply, transport the scheme map equality D.map_comp in cohomology_composition_transport, apply the composition clause of cohomologyPullbackFunctorial, and use cohomologyMap_map to interchange the coefficient transition with the second pullback. These pointwise equations give the functor laws by extensionality.

Define B.pt as AddCommGrpCat.of of H^n(L.pt), with leg i the ofHom of H.map((eG_i).inv followed by L_i) composed with cohomologyMap(c.pi_i). Precompose L.w(f) with (eG_i).inv and rewrite hG; cancel (eG_i).inv followed by (eG_i).hom to obtain the coefficient equality upperStarComp.hom followed by pullback(phi_f) followed by (eG_j).inv followed by L_j equals (eG_i).inv followed by L_i. For naturality of B, apply cohomologyMap_map, the composition clause transported across c.w(f.op), and H.map_comp_apply twice. Apply H.map to the coefficient equality to finish. Use identity isomorphisms eH and eB; AddCommGrpCat.ofHom_comp proves both displayed identification equations. This is the original two-step construction and uses no continuity or exactness result.

proof_origin.place: Canonical degree-n diagram and comparison cocone in the parent node, implemented in Lean using cohomologyPullbackFunctorial, equality transport via Sheaf.functorH, coefficient naturality, and the supplied cocone equation. The original unit route is unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_limit_canonical_cohomology_diagram
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) n))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) n) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (φ f) n) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H L.pt n))
    , ∀ i : I, B.ι.app i ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) n) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) n)
